selected.causal_hypothesis: Direct Int/Str unknown-field access uses aggregate access span and type_name int/str; vanilla reports field-only and integer/string. Existing AST field span and imported vanilla_type_name suffice. This is the generic instance fallback, not Type namespace or function callee evaluation order.

regression_surface.scope: Only direct Int/Str fallback; preserve existing actual collection methods, namespace Type errors, field values and other variants.

ranked_eligible.causal_hypothesis: Bare MathIdent callee dispatch extracts spelling before consulting the lexical callable. abs/sqrt shadowed by functions returning Content therefore can still take the hardcoded builtin branch. Local/captured scope and generic Content-returning invocation already exist in this owner. Only lexical shadowing is proposed; arbitrary non-Content returns, imported numeric functions, generic math casts and qualified-field spans remain separate.

regression_surface.scope: Math call resolution branch, not scalar formula nor return conversion. A future repair must preserve unshadowed native branches, aliases/captured scope, names that are not functions, warning behavior and argument occurrences. Current Content-only controls isolate this branch.
